test_event_wall_page_loads.title: The Event Wall page shows its breadcrumb and Add button

steps.action: Open Admin > General and click View on the Event Wall card.
steps.expected: The breadcrumb reads General > Event Wall and an enabled Add Configuration button is shown.

test_event_wall_has_configuration_area.title: The configuration table renders its column headers

steps.action: Open Admin > General and click View on the Event Wall card.
steps.expected: The table's columns are Configuration Name, Site, No of Devices and Devices, followed by an unlabelled actions column.

test_event_wall_grid_layout.title: The table shows configurations or the measured empty state

steps.action: Open Admin > General and click View on the Event Wall card.
steps.expected: The table lists configurations, each with a name, a site and a device count, or one row reading "No configuration found.".

test_event_wall_site_selector.title: The Add form lists the configured site under Available Cameras

steps.action: Open Admin > General, click View on the Event Wall card, then click Add Configuration.
steps.expected: The Add Event Wall Configuration form opens with an empty Configuration Name field (placeholder Enter Configuration Name) and an Available Cameras panel listing the configured site with its device count.

steps.action: Expand the site.
steps.expected: Its All Cameras group declares the same device count as the site row.

test_event_wall_site_dropdown_opens.title: A site row in the Event Wall add form expands to its camera groups

steps.action: Open Admin > General > Event Wall and click Add Configuration.
steps.expected: The form opens with a Name field.

steps.action: Click the configured site's row in the cameras list.
steps.expected: The row expands and lists the All Cameras group.

steps.action: Click Cancel.
steps.expected: The form closes.

test_event_wall_has_rule_types.title: The Add form's Select Rule dropdown unlocks once a camera is ticked

steps.action: Open Admin > General, click View on the Event Wall card, then click Add Configuration.
steps.expected: The form shows a Select Rule dropdown, disabled while no camera is selected.

steps.action: Expand the site to its cameras and tick one.
steps.expected: The Select Rule dropdown is enabled.

test_event_wall_camera_checkboxes.title: Every camera row of an expanded group carries a checkbox

steps.action: Open Admin > General, click View on the Event Wall card, click Add Configuration, then expand the configured site down to a camera group and click it.
steps.expected: The group's camera rows are listed under Available Cameras, each with a checkbox.

steps.action: Count the checkboxes against the device count the group row shows.
steps.expected: One checkbox per device.

test_event_wall_toggle_checkbox.title: A camera selection control can be toggled

steps.action: Open Admin > General, click View on the Event Wall card, click Add Configuration, then expand the configured site down to a camera group and click it.
steps.expected: The group's camera rows are listed under Available Cameras.

steps.action: Tick a camera's checkbox, then untick it.
steps.expected: The checkbox changes state on each click.

test_event_wall_save_or_apply.title: The Add form carries Cancel and Save

steps.action: Open Admin > General, click View on the Event Wall card, then click Add Configuration.
steps.expected: The form's buttons are Cancel and Save, both enabled.

test_back_to_general_from_event_wall.title: The breadcrumb returns to the General cards page

steps.action: From the Event Wall configuration page, click the General breadcrumb.
steps.expected: The General cards page is shown again.

test_event_wall_to_audit_trail_round_tri.title: Verify navigating from Event Wall to Audit Trail and back.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Events > Event Wall
steps.expected: Event Wall page loads successfully

steps.action: Note the current page state and URL
steps.expected: Event Wall is displayed with events visible

steps.action: Navigate to Admin > Audit Trail
steps.expected: Audit Trail page loads successfully

steps.action: Use browser back navigation to return
steps.expected: Browser navigates back to the Event Wall

steps.action: Verify the Event Wall landing page is displayed correctly
steps.expected: Event Wall loads with the same state as before navigating away

test_event_wall_after_refresh.title: Verify Event Wall page loads correctly after browser refresh.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Events > Event - Execution & Results
steps.expected: Event - Execution & Results page loads without errors

steps.action: Note the current state of Event duration persists before making changes
steps.expected: Initial state is observed and recorded

steps.action: Perform the action that changes Event duration persists
steps.expected: Action is completed and change is reflected in the UI

steps.action: Verify the change is displayed correctly before leaving the page
steps.expected: Updated state is visible on the current page

steps.action: Refresh the page (F5 or browser reload)
steps.expected: Page reloads completely

steps.action: Verify Event duration persists retained the changes after refresh
steps.expected: The change persisted through the page refresh

steps.action: Navigate away to a different page
steps.expected: Different page loads successfully

steps.action: Navigate back to Event - Execution & Results page
steps.expected: Event - Execution & Results page loads

steps.action: Set up precondition: after page refresh
steps.expected: Precondition is met (after page refresh)

steps.action: Verify Event duration persists still reflects the saved changes
steps.expected: Changes persist after navigating away and back

test_event_wall_scrollable.title: The page survives scrolling (synchronous, no settle)

steps.action: On the Event Wall configuration page, scroll down and back up.
steps.expected: The page is back at the top and the breadcrumb still reads General > Event Wall.
